articles.title: WHO calls for 'intensified' response as DR Congo Ebola cases near 4,000
articles.description: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak is spreading, with the number of infections rising rapidly. Declared in mid-May, this seventeenth Ebola outbreak has already claimed more than 1,700 lives. To address this situation, the World Health Organisation has called for an "intensified" medical response. Teams of doctors have been sent to the DR Congo, and specialised centres have been set up in the hardest-hit provinces while trials to find an effective vaccine continue.

related.title: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak outpaces response as health workers strike over pay
related.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic ⁠of Congo is spreading faster than efforts to fight it, WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Wednesday. Families said many frontline workers in Ituri province, the epicentre of the outbreak, have gone on strike over pay issues, worsening access to healthcare.

articles.title: Egyptian ​forward Salah signs two-year contract with Turkish club Trabzonspor

articles.title: French winemakers worry about 'smoky taste' after wildfires
articles.description: French winemakers affected by this summer’s wildfires are in limbo as the grape harvest approaches, fearing their 2026 vintage could have burnt flavours that would compromise sales.

articles.title: Lebanese journalist deliberately targeted by Israeli attack, probe reveals
articles.description: Three rights groups have released findings of a probe into the Israeli attack which killed Lebanese journalist Amal Khalil in April. The investigation by Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International and The Legal Agenda shows Israel deliberately targeted the 42-year-old and her camerawoman, who was wounded in the attack. According to the UN human rights office, deliberate attacks on civilians is considered a war crime. Details with FRANCE 24 correspondent in Israel, Noga Tarnopolsky.

articles.title: Cuba: What does Trump really want?
articles.description: 🇨🇺 Cuba is facing its worst economic and social crisis in decades while Washington is piling on sanctions and increasing pressure on the regime like never before. 🇺🇸 Why now? What’s really driving Trump’s interest in the island? And how far would the United States be prepared to go? ➡️ Find out in our latest long-form analysis on the France 24 English YouTube channel.

articles.title: Israel charges settler for killing Palestinian activist Awdah Hathaleen in occupied West Bank
articles.description: Israel on Thursday charged a settler, Yinon Levi, with the killing of prominent Palestinian activist Awdah Hathaleen in the West Bank in July 2025. This marks the first time since the October 7, 2023 attacks that an Israeli has been indicted for the death of a Palestinian in the occupied territory, according to Israeli rights group B’Tselem.

articles.title: #Ebola: DR Congo strains to keep up with resurgence of epidemic
articles.description: DR Congo has recorded nearly 4,000 confirmed cases of Ebola and over 1,800 deaths, as the epidemic resurges. The country is experiencing the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

articles.title: L'Ukraine frappe des raffineries, la Russie vise une gare et un navire
articles.description: Le président ukrainien, Volodymyr Zelensky, s'est félicité de ces frappes ayant touché, à plus de 1 300 km du front. Le ministère de la Défense russe a pour sa part annoncé avoir abattu dans la nuit 605 drones ukrainiens au-dessus d'une vingtaine de ses régions et de la Crimée annexée.

articles.title: Faut-il durcir les sanctions contre les incendiaires ?
Pour "limiter le phénomène de 'l'achat coup de cœur", jusqu'à 1 500 euros de contravention pour les animaleries qui vendent des chats et chiens
articles.description: L'interdiction de la vente était entrée en vigueur en 2024, en application d'une loi de 2021, mais il n'y avait pas eu de décret pour préciser les sanctions en cas d'illégalité.

articles.title: France's timber industry rushes to process trees charred by wildfires
articles.description: Fires across France have left behind mountains of cut and burned wood. More than 35,000 metric tons of trees were chopped down to urgently create firebreaks and slow the spread of the flames. But what will become of all these trees? The timber industry is now under heavy strain. It will take more than two years to remove and process it all. Story by Caitlin Brown.

articles.title: UN warns drone attacks have become leading cause of civilian death in Sudan
articles.description: The UN says drone attacks have become the leading cause of death in Sudan, accounting for 80% of civilian casualties during the first four months of 2026. Sudan plunged into all-out war in April 2023, between the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and the Sudanese military, leaving at least 59,000 people killed, according to Armed Conflict Location & Event Data, a conflict monitoring group. Aid groups say the figure is an undercount and the true number could be many times higher.

articles.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : la Suède va remettre à Kiev un navire de la flotte fantôme russe
articles.description: Le navire avait été arraisonné au début de mars et transportait, selon l’Ukraine, du blé ukrainien volé des territoires occupés. La Cour suprême de Suède a refusé d’examiner le recours déposé par l’armateur, confirmant ainsi les deux jugements précédents qui ordonnent la remise à Kiev du bateau et de sa cargaison, a-t-elle expliqué dans sa décision du 4 août.

articles.title: « Nous vivons comme prisonniers d’une force étrangère » : en Iran, le peuple pris en étau entre la répression et l’effondrement économique
articles.description: TÉMOIGNAGES - Épuisés par la répression, la guerre et l’effondrement économique, des habitants de Téhéran et d’autres villes brisent le silence. Leurs récits révèlent un peuple prêt à tout pour faire tomber la République islamique.

articles.description: In Germany, a drone carrying an explosive device was discovered and defused on the tarmac at Leipzig Airport. A second flying object then struck a cargo plane, causing minor damage. Air traffic was suspended for two hours. A Russian connection is being suggested. The interior minister describes a new dimension of threat to Germany. Story by Morgan Ayre.

articles.title: Pourquoi l'Ukraine n'arrive-t-elle plus à abattre les missiles balistiques russes ?

articles.title: « Avec ses résumés rédigés par l’IA, Google ne vous redirige plus : il vous garde chez lui grâce à la marchandise des autres »

articles.title: Agrandir sa maison sans gros travaux : la tendance des mini-studios à installer sur son terrain séduit de plus en plus
articles.description: Avez-vous déjà rêvé d'agrandir votre maison, mais sans déménager ? Et, dans l'idéal, sans même faire de travaux C'est possible avec cette nouvelle tendance : une sorte de studio, comme une mini-maison, à installer à côté de l'habitation principale. Explications.
